fixtures.name: faceit-de_mirage-6de46e85
fixtures.notes: Round 1 is a knife round (detected via is_knife_round; excluded from stats by default) - that was the only Awpy discrepancy here. Removed from ground truth: babaya0310.assists, cntoz.assists, cntoz.kast - FACEIT computes assists flash-inclusive and damage-based, unlike Awpy's game kill/flash assist attribution; cntoz KAST hinges on those assists. Also removed babaya0310.multikill_rounds - FACEIT's Multi Kills is not the standard rounds-with-N-kills metric (Awpy correctly counts 4 rounds of 2 kills; FACEIT reports 2), likely a rapid-succession count. cntoz's multikill_rounds is kept (5=5).

fixtures.name: esea-de_dust2-2c5bdd12
fixtures.notes: Round 1 is a knife round (all-melee side-decider); Awpy detects it (is_knife_round on rounds) and stats excludes it by default. Removed from ground truth: jared.assists, 1umar.assists, and 1umar.kast. ESEA computes assists flash-inclusive and damage-based (a lower threshold, and it can credit several assisters per kill), whereas Awpy reads the game single kill/flash assist attribution (jared's lone assist is a flash assist; 1umar's 4th is an ESEA damage assist the game did not credit). 1umar.kast hinges on that ESEA-only assist round (Awpy 73.7 vs ESEA 78.9).

fixtures.name: hltv-de_inferno-2395492
fixtures.notes: Removed from ground truth: (1) dgt.flash_assists - HLTV counts flash assists via flash->kill correlation, but Awpy reads the game assistedflash flag; dgt has 0 game-credited flash assists (the whole match records only 6 total), so HLTV 8 is not comparable. (2) Jame.kast - Jame KAST hinges on round 17, a pure flash assist (0 damage: Jame blinded dgt, xiELO got the kill); Awpy counts flash assists toward the KAST A component while HLTV counts only damage/kill assists, giving Awpy 78.3 vs HLTV 73.9. Definitional difference; Awpy is internally correct against the game data.
